lead: A chain-switch failure in `.loop/log.md` numbers its check in the *folded* goal, not in the goal file you will open — and the reason may already be fixed.
body: `loop.py`'s `install_next` validates the live copy after `goal-switch.py` has folded the previous goal's floor checks in above the entry's own, so the index is offset by the floor count `goal-switch.py` prints on its first line. Run `python tools/chain.py --check`, which validates every queued entry, before spending anything on what the message says.
